name: RT-Safe
summary: Evaluates vision-language models on simulated urban navigation in which the environment continues to evolve during inference and action execution, such that decision latency affects safety.
numbers: 8 VLMs; completion 91.3% static vs 94.1% real-time, collisions 12.3× higher; hardest setting 0.7% of episodes without a safety event

why.cog: Traffic rules and moving hazards under time pressure.
why.xr: Bounded harm; urban, so transfer to manipulation is unknown.
